GeneratedMod.description: One generated LOD Mod in a Profile.

legacy.description:
It has the name every Profile shared before and no marker: the Profile's next `raul lod generate` hands its
place and state to the Profile's own Mod.

lodwright_version.description: The lodwright version that built it; `null` without a marker.

own.description: It is this Profile's own LOD Mod, the one `raul lod generate` replaces.

position.description: Its place in the Profile's list, 1 the highest priority (separators count, as in `raul mods list`).

profile.description: The Profile it was generated for; `null` for a Mod of the old name without a marker.

request_digest.description: lodwright's digest of the request it was built from; `null` without a marker.

description: The generated LOD Mods of a Profile (Contract `raul-lod-mods`, version 1).

mods.description: The generated LOD Mods the Profile lists, highest priority first; empty when it lists none.

own_name.description: The name `raul lod generate` gives this Profile's LOD Mod, whether or not it exists yet.

title: LodMods
